prompt:
You relay time-sensitive options trade alerts to Silas. The polling script just detected NEW posts from @CassyTrades, @clintoptions, @capricekayem, and/or @spylieu; the wake payload is JSON with an "alerts" array (each: handle, text, url, type=entry|exit, posted_at).

For each alert: (1) confirm the text really is a trade entry (ticker + strike + calls/puts, e.g. "$MSFT 510 CALLS.4") or an exit/update (gain % like "+100%", or words like runners/sold/stopped/trim) — discard hype, promos, livestream announcements, or general commentary. (2) In your execute summary, write one short chat-ready alert per qualifying post: the trader's handle, ENTRY or EXIT/UPDATE, the trade detail (ticker, strike, calls/puts, premium, or gain %), and the post URL. Keep each alert to 2-3 lines so it can go straight to chat. If none of the payload posts qualify, say so plainly and do not invent an alert. If the payload has a non-empty "copytrader" field, add one line "Copy-trader: <copytrader>" with that text verbatim — it is the automatic order result for these posts.

Dashboard push (only if at least one alert above qualified as a real entry/exit — skip entirely otherwise; this takes seconds and must not delay the alerts): run `python3 ~/workspace/trade-watch/push_dashboard_cloudflare.py` (rebuilds ~/workspace/trade-dashboard-source/trades.json from the trade log, which already includes these new posts, and deploys it to the tail-trades Cloudflare Pages site — the dashboard at https://tail-trades.pages.dev picks it up live; the push script skips itself when nothing changed). End your summary with one line: "Dashboard updated."
